We need to determine number of C=O groups in the compound. No SMILES given. We need to get IR spectra maybe to see carbonyl stretch. Or carbon NMR? But easiest is to get IR which shows C=O stretch around 1700 cm-1. However we need count. Could also get carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons (~200 ppm). But we don't know structure.

We need to retrieve the compound? The system says "sample at hand". Probably there is a default compound loaded. We can request IR spectra. That will show peaks; we can count carbonyl peaks. Use ir_spectra tool.
